svg.title: Neovim on the VPS: Ferris Sweep cheat sheet
svg.text: Neovim on the VPS: Ferris Sweep cheat sheet
Leader is Space (right inner thumb). QWERTY base layer. A coloured key starts a group; a Shift variant is marked with a raised arrow.
Hold the left outer thumb for symbols, the right outer thumb for numbers and arrows (Esc is the left inner thumb there). Sft, Alt, Ctl, Gui: hold that home-row key.
n normal, i insert, x visual, s select, o operator, t terminal, c command line, l language
